scope: Actual headless desktop Edge at DPR 1; local and CDP network emulation. RAF intervals are page scheduling measurements, not proof of displayed cinematic frame rate. Decoder bytes exclude canvas, in-flight decoding and browser/GPU overhead. transferSize includes response overhead and cache-hit entries have zero network bytes. Aborted requests may not be represented completely in Resource Timing.
